modeling_decisions: Actual concept pixels inspected: retain broad low smooth pavement, nine unequal long incised grooves. Reject its slight divergent channels and tiny repetitive edge-cracks: all main groove trajectories aligned in one direction with small coherent natural wandering and unequal depths. Simplify irregular cutaway sides. A continuous closed mesh has top channels cut down into rock, no added rails, texture or color-only stripes. Low gentle surface undulation remains subordinate to incisions, no tall stoss/lee knob.
